Subject: Application for Goat Support Assistance
Dear Sir/Madam,
I am writing to apply for goat support assistance from your organization. My name is Mohammad Tarif and I reside in Narayanganj with my family. I am a physically challenged individual and have been facing financial difficulties due to my inability to work.
My wife is healthy and takes care of our children, but it has become increasingly challenging for her to manage the household expenses alone. We have previously raised ducks and poultry, but we no longer have the space at our residence for such activities. Therefore, I am interested in starting a goat rearing business as an alternative source of income.
I kindly request your support in this endeavor by providing me with a goat. I am committed to taking care of the goat and ensuring its well-being. I will also provide regular updates on its progress and any challenges faced.
Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to hearing from you soon regarding my request.
Sincerely,
Mohammad Tarif
